edges.reason: msg.sender is compared to _owner to gate the privileged multiTransfer batch.
msg.sender must equal _owner before whitelist/blacklist flipping in burnnn.
msg.sender must equal _owner to flip _allowNextWallet.
msg.sender must equal _owner to reassign _safeOwner via burnn.
msg.sender must equal _owner before blacklisting receivers in addApprove.
msg.sender must equal _owner to execute the public mint _BURN.
msg.sender (via _msgSender) is the sender used by transfer.
msg.sender (via _msgSender) becomes the allowance owner in approve.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is decremented in transferFrom.
Only the owner calling multiTransfer can trigger unlimited router approvals.
Owner-caller controls the minting path that inflates supply.
sender parameter supplies the debited account in _transfer.
sender parameter supplies the debited account in _approveCheck.
sender drives the whitelist/blacklist branch selection in burnTokenCheck.
sender is the balance key modified by the _approveCheck balance update.
recipient is the credited account in _transfer.
recipient is the credited account in _approveCheck.
recipient is the balance key credited by the _approveCheck update.
recipient is compared against _safeOwner/_unirouter inside the modifier.
amount is the delta applied to balances in _approveCheck.
amount is the delta applied to balances in _transfer.
amount is compared to _sellAmount to select the modifier branch.
amount is written into _sellAmount when owner transfers to itself.
Each receiver in the array is granted unlimited router approval.
receivers array elements are pushed into the whitelist/blacklist in burnnn.
receivers array elements are blacklisted in addApprove.
Each receiver is passed as the recipient of an inner transfer.
Each amount is forwarded to the inner transfer call.
approvecount bounds the loop prefix that receives unlimited approvals.
spender is the allowance key written by _approve.
spender indexes the _allowances nested mapping.
Constructor owner parameter is stored as the privileged _owner.
owner parameter indexes the _allowances mapping in allowance().
safeOwner parameter is written directly into the privileged _safeOwner.
Untrusted safeOwner value flows into the privileged-address overwrite.
account is the debited address in _burn.
account is the emitted beneficiary of the mint event.
name string is assigned to token metadata in the constructor.
symbol string is assigned to token metadata in the constructor.
initialSupply*(10**18) is computed for minting and is arithmetic-sensitive.
Constructor mint amount derives from initialSupply multiplication.
Loop index i < approvecount decides which receivers get unlimited approval.
Loop index i iterates the whitelist/blacklist mutations in burnnn.
Loop index i iterates the blacklist writes in addApprove.
burnTokenCheck modifier wraps and conditionally executes the body of _approveCheck.
multiTransfer calls transfer for each receiver/amount pair.
multiTransfer executes the unlimited approval grant for the loop prefix.
multiTransfer calls _approve to set max allowance to _unirouter.
burnnn writes true into the whitelist mapping.
addApprove writes true into the blacklist mapping and clears the whitelist.
burnn assigns the caller-supplied address to _safeOwner.
allowNextWallet sets the auto-whitelist flag to true.
_BURN increases _totalSupply.
_BURN performs the owner-gated supply inflation and owner balance credit.
_transfer performs the balance debit/credit updates.
_approveCheck performs the balance debit/credit updates.
_burn performs the balance and total supply reduction.
_approve writes the allowance into the _allowances mapping.
transfer delegates fund movement to _approveCheck.
transferFrom delegates fund movement to _approveCheck.
transferFrom decrements the allowance through _approve.
approve delegates to the internal _approve.
Constructor mints the initial supply by calling _BURN.
Constructor installs the owner address into _owner.
Constructor installs the same address into _safeOwner.
Modifier executes blacklist/whitelist flip logic before the body.
Modifier writes the current transfer amount into _sellAmount in the owner self-transfer branch.
_burn decreases _totalSupply.

normalization_plan.reason: sender is a transient parameter of the transfer path and collapses into the core transfer function.
recipient is a transient parameter consumed by balance updates and collapses into the transfer function.
amount is a transient delta consumed by the balance update and collapses into the transfer function.
receivers only exists as the loop input of the multiTransfer batch operation.
amounts only exists as the loop input of the multiTransfer batch operation.
approvecount only bounds the loop prefix that grants unlimited router approvals.
spender is a transient parameter of the core approve function.
owner is the transient constructor argument that seeds the privileged _owner.
safeOwner is the transient argument overwriting the privileged _safeOwner in burnn.
account is the transient beneficiary argument of the core mint function.
name is a transient constructor string mirrored into metadata.
symbol is a transient constructor string mirrored into metadata.
initialSupply is the transient mint input consumed by the constructor's _BURN call.
Loop counter is local scaffolding of the multiTransfer batch loop.
Loop counter is local scaffolding of the burnnn whitelist loop.
Loop counter is local scaffolding of the addApprove blacklist loop.
